# Is There a Burn Ban?

> Answers one question for US counties: is there a burn ban right now? Data comes from official state feeds (forestry agencies, fire marshals, emergency management), refreshed hourly. Informational only. Always confirm with the official source before burning.

Coverage: live county-level data for Oklahoma, Texas, Florida, Indiana, Louisiana and Mississippi. Iowa is positive-only: we can confirm active bans but not their absence. Every other state returns status "unknown" with a link to the official agency. "unknown" never means burning is allowed. Cities, fire districts, tribes and federal land managers can have stricter rules than the county.

## API (GET, JSON, CORS open, no key)

- [Status by ZIP](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?zip=74103): one result per county the ZIP touches; `ambiguous` is true when there are several.
- [Status by coordinates](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?lat=36.154&lon=-95.993)
- [Status by county FIPS](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?fips=48453)
- [Plain-text answer](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?zip=74103&format=text)
- [One county](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/counties/40143)
- [All active bans](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/bans) and [by state](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/bans?state=TX)
- [Coverage and source health](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/coverage)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://isthereaburnban.com/openapi.json)

Status values: `ban`, `restricted` (partial or activity-specific limits), `none` (the official source covers this county and reports no ban), `unknown` (no feed, feed failed, or stale).

## MCP

- Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://isthereaburnban.com/mcp (stateless, no auth). Tools: `check_burn_ban` ({zip} | {lat, lon} | {fips}), `list_active_bans` ({state?}), `coverage`.

## Pages

- County pages: https://isthereaburnban.com/us/{state}/{county-slug}/ (e.g. /us/ok/tulsa-county/)
